evals.name: what-is-preflight
evals.prompt: What is autopilot-preflight and how do I use it?
evals.expected_output: Explains that it extracts source system data into DuckDB for Autopilot, lists the main commands, and describes the typical workflow

assertions.text: Explains the purpose: extracting source system data into DuckDB for Autopilot
Lists the main commands: test, discover, inspect column-stats, validate-date-filter-spec, run
Describes the typical workflow order: test → discover → date-filter-spec → run
Mentions that --interactive must NOT be used in tool calls

evals.name: snowflake-connection-setup
evals.prompt: How do I set up a Snowflake connection for autopilot-preflight?
evals.expected_output: Explains the connections.toml format, shows example configurations, lists supported authenticators

assertions.text: Points to ~/.snowflake/connections.toml as the configuration file
Shows at least one example connection configuration in TOML format
Lists supported authenticators including snowflake, snowflake_jwt, externalbrowser, oauth
Mentions that --connection NAME is required on every snowflake subcommand

evals.name: export-guidance
evals.prompt: I need to export data from our Snowflake database for the Autopilot pipeline. Walk me through it.
evals.expected_output: Walks through the full workflow: verify connection, discover schema, generate date-filter spec, then run export with appropriate flags

assertions.text: Starts with testing the connection before any data operation
Recommends running discover before exporting to understand the schema
Mentions the date-filter-spec skill for classifying tables
Explains sampling strategies and their trade-offs
